# Elite Baseball Training

> > Elite Baseball Training provides Chicago youth baseball instruction, biomechanics assessments, and professional coaching led by Justin Stone.

Based in Chicago at Bradley Fieldhouse, Elite Baseball Training offers private lessons, KVEST biomechanics assessments, and travel baseball programs. The organization specializes in data-driven player development using advanced technology like force plate analysis and movement screening.

## Key Topics

- KVEST biomechanics assessment
- Swing analysis and mechanics
- Youth baseball instruction
- Movement screening and mobility
- Chicago baseball training
- Player evaluation and development
- Force plate analysis
- Pitching mechanics
- Infield and catching instruction
- Travel baseball programs
- Justin Stone coaching methodology
- Bradley Fieldhouse facility
- USA Baseball partnerships
- College player assessments

## Training Programs & Services

- [Private Lessons](https://www.elitebaseballtraining.com/private-lessons): Private baseball lessons by Justin Stone at Bradley Fieldhouse, Chicago
- [College Summer Assessments](https://www.elitebaseballtraining.com/college-summer-assessments): College player assessments using BioTech Cage and biokinematic analysis

## Coaching Staff

- [Joel Toribio](https://www.elitebaseballtraining.com/staff/joel-toribio): Staff profile: Joel Toribio, pitching coach with Dodgers experience
- [Charlie Price](https://www.elitebaseballtraining.com/staff/charlie-price): Staff profile: Charlie Price, catching coach at Welles Park, Chicago
- [Rich Ruffolo](https://www.elitebaseballtraining.com/staff/rich-ruffolo): Staff profile: Rich Ruffolo, Future Elite Travel Baseball Club coach

## Instructional Content & Analysis

- [Infield Receiving Position](https://www.elitebaseballtraining.com/videos/infield-receiving-position): Instructional video on infield receiving position and defensive skills
- [1 Hand or 2 Hand Finish? You'll be surprised of the answer.](https://www.elitebaseballtraining.com/1-hand-or-2-hand-finish-youll-be-surprised-of-the-answer): Video analysis comparing one-hand vs two-hand batting finish techniques
- [Common Pitching Mis-Teaches #4 – "Push Off the Mound"](https://www.elitebaseballtraining.com/common-pitching-mis-teaches-4-push-off-the-mound): Travis Kerber explains common pitching mechanics mistakes and corrections
- [Will Connor Gillaspie Continue His Torrid Pace? – Swing Analysis](https://www.elitebaseballtraining.com/will-connor-gillaspie-continue-his-torrid-pace-swing-analysis): Connor Gillaspie White Sox swing analysis by Justin Stone
